invariants.statement: Every certified action has one unique selected-control identity.
No hidden post-certification modification is permitted.
If selected differs from executed, the transformation is explicit, creates a new identity, and requires re-certification.
Every safety certificate references the exact committed executable-control identity and vector.
Nominal, alternative, and every backup control share one actuator-admission authority.
Terminal zero action and zero-hold share the same actuator semantics.
No layer may define an independent actuator authority.
Unknown actuator semantics cannot silently pass or support a physical-executability claim.
No runtime fallback to an uncertified desired or legacy control is committed.
The controller desired command is not automatically a certified command.
The current successful simulation path has selected-control equals executed-control with no hidden transform.
Normative benchmark bounds do not imply deployment or physical actuator readiness.
